title: BrokenMath: A Benchmark for Sycophancy in Theorem Proving with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the BrokenMath benchmark, which consists of advanced mathematical theorems modified to contain plausible but demonstrably false statements, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to categorize whether the model uncritically accepts the false user premise or correctly identifies and refutes it.
